setup.title: Set up Budget Owl
setup.lede: This instance is new. Create the first account — it becomes the owner of your household.
setup.operatorNote: You are the person running this instance, so you will be able to see everything anyone in your household records. Anyone you invite is told that before they join.
setup.name: Your name
setup.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A long phrase is stronger than a clever short one.
setup.baseCurrencyHint: The currency totals are shown in by default. Each member can choose to see another.
login.title: Sign in
login.lede: Welcome back. Sign in to see your household's budget.
login.heading: Your account
login.notice.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
login.notice.created: Your account is ready. Sign in to continue.
login.notice.joined: You have joined the household. Sign in to continue.
role.OWNER.description: everything, including inviting and removing people
role.MEMBER.description: can see and change the household's money
role.VIEWER.description: can see the household's money, but not change it
noHousehold.title: You are not part of a household yet
noHousehold.body: You are signed in, but nobody has added you to a household. Ask the person who runs this instance for an invitation link, then open it in this browser.
household.title: Household
household.lede: The household is the shared pot of money everyone here sees. This instance holds one.
household.name: Household name
household.baseCurrencyHint: Totals are shown in this currency unless a member chooses another in their preferences.
household.ownerOnlyEdit: Only an owner can change these.
members.heading: Members
members.removeMessage: {name} will lose access to this household straight away and be signed out everywhere. What they recorded stays in the household.
members.leaveMessage: You will lose access straight away. What you recorded stays in the household, and you will need a new invitation to come back.
members.soleOwner: You are the only owner. Make someone else an owner before you can leave.
invite.title: Invite someone
invite.intro: Create a link and send it to them however you like — a message, or read it out. There is no email.
invite.emailHint: Just a label so you can tell invitations apart. The link, not the address, is what lets someone join.
invite.shareIntro: Share this link with {email}. This is the only time it is shown.
invite.copyManual: The link is selected. Copy it with your keyboard.
invite.credentialWarning: Treat this link like a password: anyone who has it can join this household as {role}. It works once and expires {expires}.
invite.linkUnavailable: The link could not be built. Cancel this invitation and create a new one.
invite.revoked: This link has been revoked and can no longer be used.
devices.title: Devices
devices.lede: Every browser and phone where you are signed in. Sign one out and it stops working immediately.
devices.heading: Where you are signed in
devices.revoked: That device has been signed out.
devices.confirmMessage: This is the browser you are using now. You will be signed out and taken to the sign-in screen.
preferences.title: Your preferences
preferences.lede: These are yours alone. They change what you see, never what is recorded, so everyone in the household can read the same figures their own way.
preferences.heading: Display
preferences.currencyHint: Each account keeps its own currency; this is the one totals are shown in for you.
preferences.localeHint: Text appears in this language where a translation exists, and in English otherwise. Dates and numbers always follow your choice.
join.title: Join a household
join.lede: Someone has invited you to share a household's budget on this Budget Owl instance.
join.disclosure.heading: Before you join: who can see your finances
join.disclosure.operator: The person who runs this instance can see everything you record in it: every transaction, every balance, every note.
join.disclosure.nothingHidden: Budget Owl does not hide your data from them, and everyone else in the household can see it too.
join.disclosure.trust: Only join if you are comfortable sharing your finances with the person who runs this server.
join.accountNote: New here? Enter your name and choose a password. Already have an account on this instance? Leave both fields empty and you will be added with it.
join.name: Your name
join.signedInBody: An invitation can only be accepted by someone who is signed out. Sign out here, and this page will let you accept it.
